sourceIssues.sourceAnchor: PDF277 proof first paragraph / supplemental PDF23 Theorem2.8
sourceIssues.evidence: Theorem2.8 requires convex differentiability over an open set containing V. Theorem15.30 only states losses subdifferentiable on V and invokes Theorem2.8 to produce a constrained optimality subgradient.
sourceIssues.verdict: The cited theorem does not discharge that general application as printed. No counterexample to Theorem15.30 is established.
sourceIssues.affineScope: Affine losses and the quadratic potential on X=E are differentiable everywhere, so this specific citation mismatch does not invalidate the specialized target.

sourceIssues.evidence: Algorithm provides eta_1,...,eta_T>0; theorem prints eta_(t+1)<=eta_t for t=1,...,T. Eta_(T+1) is undeclared in that finite input list.
sourceIssues.verdict: Preserve printed range; record unresolved boundary indexing. No automatic change to T-1, no human-approved repair.

sourceIssues.evidence: No existence derivation supplied in these pages for arbitrary strictly convex psi and subdifferentiable loss. The theorem is conditional on the algorithm trajectory and interior iterates.
sourceIssues.verdict: Do not infer a total general producer. Specialized projection and proximal-minimizer interface supplies its own producer, subject to separate implementation validation.

sourceIssues.evidence: eta_T and maximum over 0<=t<=T-1 require positive horizon in the displayed variable-step formula. Lean includes T=0.
sourceIssues.verdict: T=0 is a separately disclosed harmless extension of the constant-step formulas, not literal coverage of the variable-step source expression.

sourceIssues.evidence: Algorithm prints subset glyph for V within X; theorem prints subseteq.
sourceIssues.verdict: Do not infer proper-subset restriction or secretly repair typography. Lean permits V=E under the theorem subseteq reading.
